title: Kernel part of reduction torsion bound
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $I,K$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves, $F,H$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $a:F\to H$ a module morphism. If $t\ge1$ and $K^t$ annihilates $\ker(a)$ and $\operatorname{coker}(a)$, then for every $n\ge0$, $K^{2t}$ annihilates the kernel of the induced map $F/I^{n+1}F\to H/I^{n+1}H$. Kernels, cokernels and ideal products are taken in the ambient category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules.

proof.text: Use coherence on the locally Noetherian scheme to give F and H quasi-coherent instances. Kernels of their maps and their cokernels are quasi-coherent. Use the affine-power-product zero criterion on the cover of all affine opens to translate hker and hcoker to annihilation of sections.

For each positive power n, the ideal-power affine formula identifies the inclusion range with I(U)^n. The affine tensor-section comparison and image calculation identify the product inclusion range with I(U)^n times F(U). Its cokernel is quasi-coherent and its affine projection is surjective with exactly that kernel. This is proved in the private helpers power_multiplication_range and quotient_affine.

The sectionwise kernel inclusion identifies the kernel of a(U) with sections of ker(a); the affine cokernel calculation gives an isomorphism from H(U)/range(a(U)) to sections of coker(a). Transport the annihilation hypotheses through these identifications. For f,g in K(U)^t use the existing scalar quasi-inverse k, with k a(U)=fg. Lift a reduced-kernel section to z in F(U). The quotient-map square puts a(U)z in I(U)^(n+1)H(U); linearity of k puts fg z in I(U)^(n+1)F(U), so its projection vanishes. Injectivity of the reduced-kernel inclusion shows fg annihilates the original section.

Ideal.mul_le and K(U)^(2t)=K(U)^t*K(U)^t extend the product-scalar annihilation to the ideal. Apply the affine-cover vanishing criterion to the quasi-coherent reduced kernel on the cover of all affine opens. This proves the global IsZero assertion for each n.

proof_origin.note: Lean implementation of the original affine scalar quasi-inverse route, using existing proved declarations and two proved private affine-section helpers; no new holes.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentMap_reduction_torsion_kernel
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F H : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hker : IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
      (kernel a.hom)))
    (hcoker : IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
      (cokernel a.hom))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
      (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι (2 * t)).2
      (kernel (formalModuleQuotientMap I a.hom (Nat.le_refl (n + 1)))))
